metaDescription: Kevin argues Toka spyware, co-owned by Ehud Barak, could alter video evidence, citing Epstein emails and the Tyler Robinson case, with Leah's input.
summary: This video is a livestream breakdown in which Kevin argues that Toka, an Israeli-linked spyware company partly owned by Ehud Barak, may have been connected to Jeffrey Epstein. Kevin says Epstein emails show him pitching Toka to intel agencies, though he acknowledges there is no direct investment link. He claims Toka can alter or replace recorded footage without leaving metadata, and speculates it may have been used on Epstein's death footage and Utah Valley University footage in the Tyler Robinson case. He credits Leah with raising Toka earlier, discusses spoofing and Cellebrite, and concludes that video-only convictions since 2019 should be challenged.
